author: Sephal
quote:
Take away all the freedom, increase the realism to match the real world, and shackle me with a toxic, selfish, and obnoxious partner. 

That’s GTA VI in a nutshell.

author: Sephal
quote: This is everything I hoped for and more. Original FFVII is my favorite game of all time, and this is the best possible outcome for a remake! I love it!!

author: Sephal
quote:
The game is so much of an improvement over the first one. Graphically it is so much more appealing to look at (even though the first was already gorgeous). The gameplay is fun and engaging, traversal feels more exhilirating than ever.

This is the best auper hero game ever made!

author: Sephal
quote: Still excited for Elder Scrolls IV, but the way this was fumbled makes me a little worried!

author: Sephal
quote: This was everything I'd dreamed of since that 2006 PS3 tech demo. And now that rebirth is right around the corner, I'm very excited for the future of this trilogy.

author: Sephal
quote:
This was probably the most visually impressive game I've ever played. The story was solid and for an expansion it had a surprisingly large number of things to do and places to go.

Very excited to see what's next for Aloy!

author: Sephal
quote: This has quickly become one of my favorite Final Fantasy games. The story, characters, music, and combat are all simply amazing. I also think this is the best world building we've ever seen in a Final Fantasy game. As a long time fan of the series, I give this one the full 10.

author: Sephal
quote: The epic conclusion of the first arc of FFXIV that's 8 years in the making!! Unbelievable expansion!

author: Sephal
quote: Wonderful story and breathtaking soundtrack continue the trend of the game surpassing itself with every new expansion. Cannot recommend this enough.
